PERMANENT ROM

EASY TOOL Custom OS — Android 16

ANDROID 16

ROM package provided through MediaFire. Make sure the package matches the exact supported device/model before flashing.

↓ Download Permanent ROM
01
Backup your dataSave important files first. ROM installation can erase user data depending on the device and flashing method.
02
Verify the deviceConfirm the exact phone model and variant are supported by this ROM before starting.
03
Prepare the PCInstall the correct USB/device drivers and extract the downloaded ROM package to a simple folder.
04
Enter the required flashing modeUse the mode required by your package/device (for example Fastboot, Recovery, or the vendor flashing mode).
05
Flash the packageUse the flashing script or tool included with the ROM package when available, and follow its on-screen prompts.
06
Wait for the first bootDo not disconnect the device during flashing. The first boot after installation can take longer than normal.
Important: Flash only the ROM intended for the correct device/model. An incompatible package can cause boot or software problems. The exact flashing method depends on the supported device and the files included in the ROM package.
